recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s-style studio portrait of a woman with a voluminous auburn bouffant hairstyle, set against a muted teal-blue gradient background. The subject holds a small sprig of blue flowers, wearing a white sleeveless garment and a single light blue glove. The composition is framed by a thin cream border, featuring high-contrast condensed serif typography and fluid, looping script.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm auburn hair tones contrast against the cool teal background.
The vertical stack of condensed serif text balances the subject's off-center gaze.
The large, flowing script at the bottom left anchors the typographic hierarchy.
Soft, diffused lighting creates a gentle transition between the subject and the flat background.
coreInvariants: Combination of high-waisted condensed serif and decorative script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, subject positioned slightly right of center, looking off-camera to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large script lettering in the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves down to the large script, then follows the subject's gaze across to her face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant teal negative space in the upper-left and right corners to accommodate technical metadata and titles.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with medium-high value; high contrast between dark hair and light skin.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed modern serif and high-contrast copperplate-style script
letterConstructionRules: Serif text: extremely high x-height, narrow width, vertical stress.
Script text: heavy loops, variable stroke width, slanted axis, connected glyphs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'R' features a large, sweeping descender loop.
Script 'e' ends in a decorative upward flick.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Vertical stack of rigid condensed serifs paired with a large, fluid horizontal script.
graphicDevices: Geometric logo badge in upper right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, narrow verticality of the main title.
Captures the mid-century formal yet fluid script aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with a 1960s auburn bouffant hairstyle, wearing a white sleeveless top and one light blue glove, holding a sprig of blue flowers. Background is a solid muted teal with a soft vignette. Include a thin cream border around the entire frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add stacked title text in the upper-left in a cream-colored, high-contrast condensed serif. Below it, add a large name in a cream-colored, looping calligraphic script. Place small sans-serif 'STEREO' text in the upper-right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the teal background muted and not neon?
Does the script text have large, decorative loops?
Is the serif text vertically elongated?
Is there a thin cream border around the image?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cream border is consistent on all four sides.
Check that the script text does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the 'STEREO' text is small and positioned in the top right corner.
Confirm the teal background has a subtle gradient or texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [1960s Studio Portrait] with [Stacked Condensed Serif] and [Large Looping Script] over a [Muted Teal Field] framed by a [Cream Border].
